title: kbingest.py map takes a group's mapper for a language, named as extension point ingest_mappers, and writes its symbols into the map as the shipped mappers do
goal: kbingest.py map calls the mapper extensions.ingest_mappers names for a language as mapper(repo_dir, rev, files) with the files whose suffix the mapper's SUFFIXES lists; the packages, imports, entry points and symbols it returns join the map under that language in the shipped record shapes; a group mapper wins over a shipped one for its language; a mapper that raises or answers another shape adds a note naming the language and the point and maps nothing for it
